name: restic

lifecycle.note: The official 0.19.1 image tag and digest were read from GHCR. The portless manual recipe prepares a password file and empty project-owned source/repository folders; ordinary apply does not run it. Only a separately approved version probe is bundled. Real backup scope, repository initialization, backups, scheduling, and isolated restore remain pending.

security: Keep the repository password and backend credentials in private secret storage; retain the password independently for recovery.
Choose and verify an off-host repository target before claiming backup coverage.
pitfalls: Restic does not schedule backups; a recurring job needs an external scheduler and overlap protection.
A CLI container has no administrator or frontend port; the manual profile is inert on ordinary apply and its version probe does not prove backup coverage.
The recipe's managed source and repository folders are empty staging placeholders, not selected production data or an independent off-host copy.
A successful snapshot or repository check is not proof that application state restores; perform an isolated restore.
